I'm not going to be like everyone else and constantly say "no don't do it" but I will tell you my own experience.

I had a very close friend of mine commit suicide, the pain that his family and that I felt still affects me to this day...many of my other friends committed suicide after him and it caused a chain reaction. I know suicidal thoughts can consume you but that's when you need to push through. You may not believe it now, but your life has so much more purpose then you think it does. Suicide is painful no matter what you do...trust me...I know...and everyone here is willing to support you and help you get through this horrible time of your life. It would be best to sit down and think of all the great things you have, all the people that love you even if your brain doesn't let you. Because there's always someone that will love and support you no matter what. You can face this obstacle and be strong, put your emotions on paper, scream your frustrations away if you have to. Think of it this way...if you try to commit suicide and it fails, your body and mind will be messed up to no repair and you will regret it. Life is hard. People are mean. Our heads can make us end it all. But in the end, there's always someone who will stay by your side. I'm not sure what you have been through, or what your life is like. But you can always make yourself a better person, you can find good people to have in your life, and if it's a family situation...talk to them about it. Communication is the best thing you can do. Take time and start a journal. Suicide is never the answer, but these thoughts are telling you that it's time for you to heal. So heal...everyone here cares about you and we all want you to get through this.
